processOwnership.oracleFailurePrefix: Before oracle PID start referenceRequests=0/NOT_STARTED. On PID-observed start actual requests become null/UNKNOWN. Failure recovery authenticates frozen oracle authorization/provider; saves original bounded summary/progress raw bytes and SHA without JSON rewrite. A valid final summary is authoritative. If missing/unreadable, original valid progress supplies durable lower bounds only; actual total/in-flight work remain UNKNOWN. Missing progress never becomes0. Secondary read/auth/copy errors are separate and do not replace the original first failure.

resourceDerivation.scope: Enforced owned payload, serialization and artifact allocation envelope. Not a claim that V8, CPython, TypeScript compiler, esbuild, OS pages or whole process RSS are <=64MiB. Installed toolchain internal heap is unmeasured. High static review must approve this source-level charge model before runtime.

runnerCharge.formula: 4MiB + 32*S <=8MiB; S is actual UTF8 JSON byte length of all23 retained native fixture inputs encoded as raw words, all up-to13 retained source raw output strings, and ALL retained command records. The previous draft2MiB fixed charge is replaced with4MiB to cover concurrently parsed validator metrics and recipe/summary roots.
runnerCharge.retainedRoots: fixtureInputs23; sourceOutputs13; command records29; cases31KiB original literals; oracleSummary23 reply pins; replyPins23; graph/provider pins; counters/progress; current input clone/output/raw word representation/request/result raw+parsed metrics. No previous full candidate output or previous validation metric object is stored in a collection. Per-case lexical scope ends before next candidate; only source raw string remains for parity. currentCall ref is cleared after every invocation and graph finally.
runnerCharge.factor32Derivation: Raw-word encoding provides at least one16-character word plus key/container characters per numeric slot. Each scalar appears in a bounded number of ordinary input/output/raw-tree/JSON representations. The32-byte-per-encoded-byte allocation charge covers those numeric slots, array/property/container payload and simultaneous UTF16/UTF8 copies with a large fixed multiplicity. This is a declared conservative logical payload charge, not a measured V8 object-header or heap theorem. S itself is bounded before proceeding.
runnerCharge.fixed4MiBDerivation: Covers one <=256KiB validation raw buffer +UTF16 text +fixed <=256-check parsed record tree, one <=64KiB request, <=64KiB progress snapshot, cases+oracle summary/pin metadata, two current endpoint copies/output snapshots, observer/frame metadata and bounded scalar temporaries. Validator output schema caps checks256 and depth32; it is not arbitrary JSON from an untrusted module. All retained large raw-output strings and commands are additionally included in S.
runnerCharge.sourceBuildCharge: Original TS<=64KiB, effective TS<=128KiB, source bundle<=1MiB, native JS<=1MiB, compiler inputs metadata<=64KiB, native declarations/config/package metadata and serialized provider manifest are charged to build16MiB disk envelope, with their concurrently retained code buffers/text charged there too. nativeBytes is explicitly nulled after hash checks; no candidate data is allocated by build.
runnerCharge.logsReserve: Captured stdout+stderr is <=4MiB cumulative. A chunk list, concatenated Buffer and write Buffer can coexist: <=12MiB charged to24MiB reserve. Each hash stream uses64KiB blocks. Remaining reserve covers bounded final summary/progress/failure encoding and file-system metadata, not a process RSS claim.

validatorCharge.formula: WorkingBound.check whole explicit owned roots <=8MiB, with1MiB fixed scratch reserve; evaluated before decoding/validation growth, on each accumulated check, and before serialization.
validatorCharge.roots: raw request bytes, request pin graph, all original raw input/output/oracle reply/oracle summary JSON dictionaries, decoded before/after input/output, decoded ideal reference values, raw ideal literals, every accumulated exact-rational check, peak ratio, recomputed physical tensors/momenta/metrics and rounding metrics. Main serialization check still includes original artifact roots and result/detail, deduplicated by object identity.
validatorCharge.weights: Fraction:2048+16*(numeratorBits+denominatorBits), max4096bits per numerator/denominator; this charges live integer payload plus packed numerator/denominator string records and simultaneous JSON/UTF8 copies. String:256+24*length charges original text plus worst JSON escape/UTF16/UTF8 duplicates; dict512+128*entries and list256+32*entries charge current and packed containers, child payload charged recursively; bytes128+2*length; integer128+bitLength. Duplicate object IDs charged once. These are explicit fixed-provider logical allocation sums, not measured RSS.
validatorCharge.reserveDerivation: 1MiB covers fixed-size three-vector/3x3 physical recomputation scratch, Fraction arithmetic temporaries, closure/frame and encoder transient metadata. There are no matrices larger than3x3, inversions, solves, retained previous requests or adaptive loops in this validator. <=256 component checks, <=50000 visited nodes, depth<=32; factorization count0. Traversal identity set/owned ID integers/recursive frames and set-growth overlap are now charged explicitly in addition to this reserve; they are not assumed to fit inside it.
validatorCharge.serialization: Charge model includes future packed dictionaries, integer decimal strings, JSON text and UTF8 bytes before pack/dumps. Output is capped256KiB, one physical request only. Failed check detail is retained. Files/tools are hashed in64KiB streams, not loaded wholesale.
validatorCharge.traversalLifecycle: WorkingBound._visit is a class-owned static method, not a recursive nested closure. check finally clears seen/scratch and borrowed roots/last root on success and error; no deferred cyclic GC. Before each new ID allocation into the set, precharge5*current set allocation (old1x+new at most4x), existing ID integer payload plus incoming ID sys.getsizeof, scratch dict and4096bytes per active recursive frame. Actual active set/ID/frame charge remains included with payload and separate1MiB fixed reserve, all under unchanged8MiB bound. Peak includes preflight growth charge. Nodes<=50000 and depth<=32 remain unchanged.

resourceDerivation.artifactEnvelope: Combined oracle+runner evidence <=8MiB, including oracle raw/reply/progress/summary files, candidate raw inputs/outputs,26 validator request/results, child logs and runner progress/summary. Runner reserves64KiB failure and64KiB progress; actual final evidence tree excluding build is checked before PASS. Build separately<=16MiB. Oracle owns reference working8MiB and its own corrected accounting; candidate/validator working charge8MiB is sequential, not simultaneous with oracle work.24MiB fixed reserve is not an extra allocation permission.
